 by Dan Hiergesell Nov 7, 2026, 5:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Photo by Chris Unger/Zuffa LLC﻿ Dan Hiergesell is an expert voice who serves as MMAmania.com’s weekend editor, covering mixed martial arts (MMA) for more than 15 years, getting featured on programs such as Countdown to UFC and SiriusXM Fight Club, among others. Welcome to Midnight Mania!
 Let’s start the night off by taking a look back over the three biggest stories of Friday, Nov. 6, 2026.
 One UFC middleweight believes the promotion could strip division champion Sean Strickland amidst his current contract dispute . 
 Former UFC title challenger Stephen “Wonderboy” Thompson will be officially retiring next weekend at UFC 334 in New York City . 
 Eddie Hearn could be on the verge of signing another big-time UFC star .
